Provides continuous charging for eufyCam, eufyCam E, eufyCam 2, eufyCam 2 Pro, eufyCam 2C and eufyCam 2C Pro.
With the 2.6W high-efficiency solar panel and a few hours of direct sunlight per day, your camera stays charged round the clock.
The 13 ft (4 m) cable lets you place the panel where it gets the most sunlight, and the 360-degree mounting bracket and wall anchors make installation quick and flexible.
Only certified eufy Security solar panels can sync with eufyCam for correct power management. Non-certified panels may damage the eufyCam battery.
Built to withstand extreme weather conditions.
This is the only official eufy solar panel, designed to provide continuous charging for all eufyCam models.
Solar panel, 13 ft (4 m) charging cable, 360-degree mounting bracket, set of installation screws and wall anchors, 4 camera adapters and a quick start guide.
